name: @tnzi/ui-monorepo
description: Tnzi.NET Frontend Packages Monorepo - core + shadcn/vant/naive-ui UI components.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @tnzi/core build && pnpm -r --filter @tnzi/ai build && pnpm -r --filter @tnzi/shadcn build && pnpm -r --filter @tnzi/vant build && pnpm -r --filter @tnzi/naive-ui build
scripts.contracts:sync:url: dotnet run --project ../Tnzi.Cli/Tnzi.Cli.csproj -- dev contracts sync --url http://localhost:5000/swagger/v1/swagger.json --out ./packages/core/src/services --targets dto,schema,api,metadata,paths
scripts.contracts:sync: dotnet run --project ../Tnzi.Cli/Tnzi.Cli.csproj -- dev contracts sync --input ./openapi.json --out ./packages/core/src/services --targets dto,schema,api,metadata,paths
scripts.contracts:sync:check: dotnet run --project ../Tnzi.Cli/Tnzi.Cli.csproj -- dev contracts sync --input ./openapi.json --out ./packages/core/src/services --targets dto,schema,api,metadata,paths --check
